title: Native data profiling for notebook results tables
summary: You can now view profiling statistics for columns in notebook results tables. From a results table, select column headers and click Open selection details to view profiling statistics. This feature is also available in the new Databricks SQL editor. See Select data.

title: Community connectors (Beta)
summary:
Open-source connectors extend Lakeflow Connect to sources without managed connector support. They're built and maintained by the community. Use a registered connector or create your own. See Community connectors in Lakeflow Connect.On this page
- Query-based connectors for Lakeflow Connect are now generally available
- Databricks Apps horizontal scaling (Beta)
- Lakeflow Designer updates for May 29, 2026
- Workspace sidebar navigation updates
- Anthropic Claude Opus 4.8 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
- Cross-engine attribute-based access controls (Beta)
- Real-time mode in Spark Declarative Pipelines on Lakeflow, and the update_flow API are now available (Public Preview)
- Google Drive managed ingestion connector (Beta)
- Workspace admin setting for serverless notebook execution timeout
- Refresh policies and EXPLAIN CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW for materialized views are now generally available
- Removed legacy Assistant slash commands
- Automatic identity management with Microsoft Entra ID is now GA
